description: The portal to my wizarding school is at the back of a payday loan place in Windsor, Ontario. It isn't quite as cool as that magic train station, but the loan place is open late. There is also a Tim Hortons across the street. So that's nice.
instruments: Choir, Glockenspiel, Trumpets, Trombones, Tubas, Percussion
